## Description {#details}

<p>This file provides the primary interface to the instcombine pass.</p>


<p>This pass is suitable for use in the new pass manager. For a pass that works with the legacy pass manager, use <span class="doxyComputerOutput">createInstructionCombiningPass()</span>.</p>
